newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stocks lose momentum, Valmiera ends run.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stocks lose momentum, Valmiera ends run.

text.p: Latvian stocks lost momentum on Thursday and bourse newcomer Valmiera Fiberglass registered its first fall, dealers said.
Total market turnover fell to 168,000 lats from 230,000 and the Rietumu Bank bourse index closed 0.27 percent lower at 184,82 points. Rietumu said in a statement this was due to profit-taking.

Valmiera Fiberglass on the secondary list, which entered the bourse on Monday, ended its run that saw it soar from its nominal of one lat to more than two lats. It today fell almost 15 percent to 2.29 lats amid and turned over 29,500 lats.
Leading bank Unibanka, which also actively gained ground this week, ticked down four santimes to 4.46 lats as it turned over 34,500 lats, the bourse's largest trade.
Daugavpils Chain on the secondary list climbed slightly to 2.70 from 2.68 lats. It turned over 20,800 lats worth of shares.

Fish cannery Kaija was also up to 2.40 from 2.35 on volume of 20,400 lats. Other official list shares were less active. Riga Transport Fleet remained stable at 1.70 lats on business of 13,900 lats and Staburadze confectionery fell six santimes to 2.94 lats. It had volume of 10,900 lats.
Lode Brick maker traded 5,200 lats and nudhed up one santime to 2.14 lats and Roja fish cannery gained five santimes to 3.05 lats as it saw shares worth 4,300 lats changing hands.
Rigas Raugs yeast factory fell slightly to 4.05 from 4.06 lats and traded 4,300 lats of shares.
Veldze soft drinks manufacturer fell eight santimes to 0.62 santimes. It registered business of 1,300 lats.
